description: Post-generation editing of image and video assets: AI prompt edits, overlays (normalized geometry), video v2v + narration re-dub (voice/emotion/gender; language-dependent extras), version keep/discard/revert, caption edits, share links and social ad previews. In-action editing (inAction*) works on completed UGC in-action ads. editImage and imageOverlay are async: they return `candidate` with status processing (charged at submit, refunded if the edit fails) — poll imageVersions every ~5s until that version is candidate (then imageKeep / imageDiscard) or failed (show its error_message); never keep, discard or re-submit while it is still processing. Burned-in subtitles of a UGC presenter video: subtitleState reads the lines and the version token, subtitleApply fixes, retimes, adds, removes or hides them (each apply becomes a new version of the ad; poll subtitleState until rendering is false). Brand layer (the brand-font captions, plus logo mark or on-video titles, added to a finished Shorts, UGC Pro, Commercial or Film ad): brandLayer turns it off (enabled false) or back on, instantly and free; brand_layer on each ad in the campaign assets holds its state (null when there is nothing to switch). Actions: editImage, imageOverlay, uploadOverlay, imageVersions, imageKeep, imageDiscard, imageRevert, editVideo, videoOverlay, editNarration, previewNarration, videoVersions, videoKeep, videoDiscard, videoRevert, editCaption, shareLink, socialAdView, inActionState, inActionMusicTracks, inActionPrompt, inActionVoiceover, inActionVoiceoverPreview, inActionTagScript, inActionMusic, inActionRegenerate, inActionVersions, inActionKeep, inActionDiscard, inActionRevert, subtitleState, subtitleApply, brandLayer. Call adgpt_capabilities with the operationId to see an action's parameters.
name: adgpt_edit_creative
title: Edit creative
